description.value:
Traits Paradise-Touched

If you have at least 1 unspent Bandwidth when you begin a night's rest, you wake with your maximum plus 1 rather than your maximum. If you spent everything, you wake at your maximum as normal. You can never hold more than 1 point above your cap by any means, and the extra point is ordinary Bandwidth once you have it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Wake with Bandwidth max+1 if you ended the day with unspent Bandwidth.
